newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends flat, stable trend seen.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends flat, stable trend seen.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed little changed against its U.S. counterpart in a typical lacklustre Saturday session and dealers said they expected the rate to continue its stable trend.
The local unit ended at T$27.667 against Friday's T$27.662 close.
Turnover through dealers was a light US$38 million.
"No major factors can be seen in the near future to move the market either way," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
A T$27.64-68 range was seen for Monday.
